component.name: AniMathIO
component.summary: Edit and export math animation videos

description.p: AniMathIO combines a multi-track video editor with sandboxed plugins for text, LaTeX, graphs and animation. Arrange media, animate transforms with keyframes, mix audio, and export videos using the same rendering engine as the preview.
The desktop application includes the command-line renderer and eight first-party plugins.
Desktop editor improvements and release automation updates.
Rust rewrite with a multi-track editor and sandboxed WebAssembly plugins.
